sources.title: GitHub - wds-seu/guqinMM: guqin jzp ocr and music generation
sources.snippet: Guqin music generation system is aim to generate music from JZP document. Since the JZP notation doesn't include some music features, we need train our model with both document and music. The datasets includes two parts: the music parts are collected from Guqin exam videos and online video resources, the sequence parts are collected from our JZP OCR parts.

sources.title: 国风AI绘画神器来了!LiuJuan20260223Zimage镜像实测：一键生成工笔水墨人像-CSDN博客
sources.snippet: 文章浏览阅读246次，点赞7次，收藏3次。本文介绍了如何在星图GPU平台上自动化部署LiuJuan20260223Zimage国风美学生成模型v1.0镜像，快速搭建国风AI绘画环境。该镜像专为生成工笔水墨风格人像而设计，用户通过简单的文字描述，即可一键生成具有东方古典韵味的汉服人像图片，为内容创作提供高效工具。
